$comment: Name forms per profile, for finding mentions of profiled people in other profiles' text (BACKLOG I17-B/C). Each alias is a phrase of word stems: a mention matches when every word appears in order, case-sensitive, followed by at most 3 more letters (so 'Шевченк' finds Шевченко, Шевченка, Шевченкові; 'Ярослав Мудр' finds Ярослава Мудрого). Note the Ukrainian consonant changes (Теліга → Телізі, Українка → Українці): such forms are listed as their own stems. A stem shared by two profiles (Шевченк) is a namesake: every match needs a human check. Surnames that are also places or other things (Хмельницький the city, the Vernadsky station) have full-name forms only.
